title: Power calculations sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Making materials (9E); conservation of energy
source: Seeded from science/y9 lesson 23 (Power calculations sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 23: Power: watts and kilowatts. To understand power as the rate of energy transfer and how to calculate it

model.title: A kettle transfers 360 000 J in 2 minutes. Find its power.

questions.q: A lamp transfers 1200 J in 60 s. Power?
questions.model: Formula: P = E ÷ t. Time is already in seconds: 60 s. Substitute: 1200 ÷ 60 = 20. P = 20 W.

questions.q: A 2000 W heater runs for 10 s. Energy transferred?
Core: With an adult, read the power labels on four appliances. Rank them and calculate the energy each transfers in 1 minute.
questions.a: Pupils' own, e.g. kettle 3000 W: 180 000 J per minute.
questions.model: Teacher shows the first: kettle label 3000 W; E = 3000 × 60 = 180 000 J per minute.

questions.q: Extend: A microwave of 800 W heats soup for 3 minutes. How much energy?
Stretch: Why does the kettle boil water faster than the microwave heats the same water?
questions.a: It has a higher power (3000 W against 800 W), so it transfers energy to the water faster.

questions.q: Big question: why does a kettle boil water faster than a microwave warms it?
questions.a: The kettle has a higher power rating, so it transfers energy to the water faster.
